*ezdox.txt*  EZDox Vim addon

==============================================================================
CONTENTS                                                        *ezdox-contents*

1. Overview                                                     |ezdox-overview|
2. Commands                                                     |ezdox-commands|
3. Mappings                                                     |ezdox-mappings|
4. Syntax                                                       |ezdox-syntax|
5. Installation                                                 |ezdox-install|

==============================================================================
OVERVIEW                                                        *ezdox-overview*

The EZDox Vim addon helps author C and C++ Doxygen-style docstrings for
projects that use EZDox.  It is written in Vimscript and works in Vim and
Neovim.

The plugin reads the command inventory from:
>
  $EZDOX_HOME/manifests/doxygen-commands.yaml
<
If that file is not installed, a compact built-in list is used.

==============================================================================
COMMANDS                                                        *ezdox-commands*

                                                        *:EZDoxDocBlock*
:EZDoxDocBlock [kind]
        Insert a boilerplate documentation block above the cursor.

        Supported kinds:
>
  function
  class
  file
  field
<
        Example:
>
  :EZDoxDocBlock function
<

                                                        *:EZDoxCommand*
:EZDoxCommand [command]
        Insert a Doxygen command at the cursor.  Completion is populated from
        the installed Doxygen command manifest when available.

        Example:
>
  :EZDoxCommand @brief
<

                                                        *:EZDoxCommands*
:EZDoxCommands
        Open a scratch buffer listing known Doxygen commands.

                                                        *:EZDoxValidate*
:EZDoxValidate [config]
        Run:
>
  ezdox-cli config validate -C {config}
<
        If {config} is omitted, the plugin searches for EZDox.yaml, EZDox.yam,
        EZDox.json, EZDox.sexp, and EZDox.xml in the current directory.

==============================================================================
MAPPINGS                                                        *ezdox-mappings*

The plugin defines <Plug> mappings but does not bind keys by default.

>
  <Plug>(ezdox-doc-function)
  <Plug>(ezdox-doc-class)
  <Plug>(ezdox-doc-file)
  <Plug>(ezdox-commands)
<

Example user mappings:
>
  nmap <leader>df <Plug>(ezdox-doc-function)
  nmap <leader>dc <Plug>(ezdox-doc-class)
  nmap <leader>di <Plug>(ezdox-commands)
<

==============================================================================
SYNTAX                                                            *ezdox-syntax*

The addon installs syntax hooks for C and C++ after-syntax files.  Doxygen
commands are highlighted only inside documentation comments:
>
  /// @brief one-line documentation
  /**
   * @param value described parameter
   * @return described result
   */
<

Recognized comment forms include:
>
  ///
  ///<
  /**
  /*!
<

==============================================================================
INSTALLATION                                                    *ezdox-install*

Use the included installer:
>
  ./addons/vim/install.sh --vim
  ./addons/vim/install.sh --nvim
  ./addons/vim/install.sh --vim --nvim
<

The installer copies plugin files to:
>
  $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vim
  $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nvim
<
When XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset, ~/.config is used.

After installing for Vim, run:
>
  :helptags ~/.config/vim/doc
<
For Neovim, run:
>
  :helptags ~/.config/nvim/doc
<
